'''''Noway''''' was a group of 3 [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttles]] used by the [[Pakuuni Pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were used as part of an [[Attacks on Platform NL-1|assassination]] attempt on then-[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] while he was inspecting [[NL-1]] station, but they arrived too late and instead attempted to fight the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]], but were all destroyed by [[Imperial Ace]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
